description: Repairs r-cursor-1/edit-validation-order: after the last, successful Update, DBEngine.Errors still reported the previous failure, so that count readout answered nothing for that call. G has T required, U with rule <>'bad' and a unique index, and table rule [N] < 1000. Sequence 1 on a dynaset with held Fields: AddNew, set U 'bad', read U and EditMode; Update (T unset and U bad), Errors, EditMode; set T 't'; Update, Errors; set U 'u1' (duplicate); Update, Errors; set U 'u9' and N 2000; Update, Errors; set N 3; Update (no Errors read after it), read ID, EditMode; a new snapshot reads every row of G. Sequences 2 and 3 on fresh dynasets: AddNew, then U 'bad' and T Null, or T Null and U 'bad'; Update, Errors, CancelUpdate. Sequence 4: Field U ValidateOnSet True, Edit, set U 'bad', Errors, EditMode, U, CancelUpdate. Errors is read right after each call that can fail and not after a call that succeeds. Asks the check order, which check runs at assignment and which at Update. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
